title: Returned after the alert
body: The receiver was in for repair during the county alert. Its battery still held charge; the owner signed for it the next morning and noted the missed shift cost lunch.
rival_reading: A field monitor could have been under repair during a test transmission, and a charged battery does not prove it was tuned to the right channel.
gloss: A repair window overlaps a public alert while the radio remains powered.

title: No fault at the plot
body: The field trial's receiver came back marked 'no fault found,' though it stopped transmitting at the plot. The owner asked to hold the invoice until after harvest; the bench still wants payment.
rival_reading: A response crew might have borrowed an ordinary radio and returned it with a disputed repair bill; the note does not establish what the field trial measured.
gloss: A field-trial radio failure and its unpaid repair are recorded together.

cites.quote: Over 20 years experience in electronic repair and maintenance.
